$comment: DRAFT, NOT FROZEN. Values follow the audit in docs/validation-protocol-v1.md. Site ids are placeholders until a partner site exists; no truth digest is sealed. Freezing requires check_freezable() to return no reasons and an explicit approval.

primary_tolerance.name: pas128-ql-b1-reading
primary_tolerance.source: PAS 128 QL-B1 as reported by secondary sources (see docs/validation-protocol-v1.md section 3); primary text not yet read

matching.coverage_radius_basis: half the 0.10 m line spacing of brief section 1.3

runtime.reference_survey: 8 x 10 m, two frequencies, brief section 1.3

pooling: If there is more than one test site, the gates apply to the pooled test-site counts AND each test site is reported separately. The pooling set is fixed at freeze. Development data never enter the gates.

revisions.change: Recall bounds are one-sided at alpha 0.05 (the brief's section 6.4 numbers were two-sided 95%).
revisions.reason: The gate is a one-sided claim (recall at least 0.6), and this matches the one-sided false-alarm bound.

revisions.change: min_n 16 per class group in the test data (pooled test sites allowed), replacing the brief's per-site 7 linear / 5 compact.
revisions.reason: With 5 compact objects the gate cannot be passed even at 5/5; with 7 linear only at 7/7 (P(pass) 0.48 at true recall 0.9). At n = 16, P(pass) is 0.79 at true recall 0.9.

revisions.change: Verified-empty area at least 20 m2 in the test data (brief: 12 m2).
revisions.reason: 12 m2 passes only with zero false alarms; 19 m2 is needed to tolerate one.

revisions.change: Horizontal tolerance fixed at 0.15 m (no depth-proportional term); depth tolerance 15% of depth, reported only.
revisions.reason: The brief's max(0.15 m, 0.15 x depth) mixed PAS 128 QL-B1's horizontal and depth terms; as reported, the standard has no depth-proportional horizontal term.

uncertainties.statement: PAS 128 tolerances are taken from secondary sources (survey-company pages), not from the BSI text of PAS 128:2022.
uncertainties.resolution: Read the primary text before freezing; if it is paid, obtaining it needs approval.

uncertainties.statement: ASCE 38-22 QL-B: secondary sources cite 0.2 ft (about 60 mm) horizontal as the accuracy with which the MARKED position is tied to the survey datum, not a detection tolerance; vertical figures are ambiguous between QL-A and QL-B.
uncertainties.resolution: Not used as a gate; read the primary text before any claim of ASCE 38 equivalence.

uncertainties.statement: No standard covers compact non-utility objects (stones, rubble, voids). The compact tolerance (0.15 m plus half the largest dimension) is a project choice.
uncertainties.resolution: Stated as a choice in every report.

uncertainties.statement: Gate power is modest: at n = 16 a detector with true recall 0.8 passes with probability 0.35.
uncertainties.resolution: Accepted: the gate certifies recall of at least 0.6 with confidence; it does not estimate recall. Report point estimates and intervals alongside the verdict.

uncertainties.statement: coverage_radius_m depends on the realised line spacing, and min_length_fraction 0.5 is a project choice.
uncertainties.resolution: Fix both at freeze from the acquisition actually performed.

uncertainties.statement: Site ids are placeholders and no partner site is confirmed (R0).
uncertainties.resolution: Bind real site ids and seal truth digests before freezing.
